cases.rationale: Synthetic: [1, 2], [ 3 ], [2 ,9], [4,  5] and [1,\t3] are markers with spaces or a tab; 9 is out of range (5 citations) and removed, leaving [2]; the standalone [ 9 ] is removed with the space before it; [05] resolves to citation 5 and renders as [5]; kept markers render without spaces; [S, M] is not numeric and [1,\n2] spans a newline, so those two paragraphs are uncited.

Live (JM-004 smoke Q2): markers [2, 5, 6], [2, 3], [1, 5] and [1, 3, 5, 6] in one paragraph resolve within 8 citations to 5 distinct URLs (citations 1, 2, 3, 5, 6). Under the original rule this answer resolved 0 citations.
